capabilities: : Fetch remote files into the current note
: Restore exported files back into your vault
: Filter or ignore files while exporting
: Store file paths in note properties
extras: Screwdriver notes can become very large; consider excluding them from plugins that scan Markdown content heavily, such as Templater or Dataview.
intentEvidence: Utility to put any files in and out under your vault.
problem: Standard Markdown synchronization workflows often fail to handle non-standard files, plugin configurations, or hidden files within the vault.
summary: Screwdriver exports files from the vault into a Markdown note and restores them later, allowing movement of non-standard files like themes and plugins.
